kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem create-data-ingestion --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --data-ingestion-mode realtime --data-source-id ds-3g6lyf4eonngyohaq7tr --normalization-rule-id nr-hdmady54piigkjfv17yp --data-source-editable true --data-ingestion-state-code UserUnauthorized --capacity-count 10 --stream-job-id 802c0129b6cfd50861d4b25deea29afb --data-ingestion-type custom --scan-data-source-id ds-014frtpy28m5ct2eoyo1 --update-time 1733269771123 --normalization-rule-editable true --product-id alibaba_cloud_sas --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataIngestion

parameters.help_en:
The region of the management center for threat analysis. Specify the management center based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside outside China.
cn-shanghai: The actual effective value. RegionId refers to the management center location, which is a different dimension from the API endpoint region (cn-shanghai)
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域。
cn-shanghai：实际有效取值。RegionId 为管理中心所在地概念，与 API 端点地域（cn-shanghai）是不同维度
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
This parameter is required in practice. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns a 400 error: "The specified Lang can not be empty."
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
注意：此参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误「The specified Lang can not be empty.」
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The data ingestion mode. Valid values:
realtime
scan
parameters.help_zh:
数据接入模式。取值：
realtime
scan
parameters.name: data_ingestion_mode

parameters.help_en:
The data source ID.
This parameter is required in practice. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns a 400 error: "The specified DataSourceId is invalid."
Before calling this operation, call the CreateDataSource operation to create a data source and obtain the data source ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据源ID。
注意：此参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误「The specified DataSourceId is invalid。」
调用前需先调用 CreateDataSource 接口创建数据源，并获取数据源ID
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en:
The normalization rule ID.
Before calling this operation, call the CreateNormalizationRule operation to create a normalization rule and obtain the normalization rule ID
parameters.help_zh:
标准化规则ID。
调用前需先调用 CreateNormalizationRule 接口创建标准化规则，并获取标准化规则ID
parameters.name: normalization_rule_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the data source is editable
parameters.name: data_source_editable

parameters.help_en: The status code for data ingestion exceptions
parameters.name: data_ingestion_state_code

parameters.help_en: The number of associated security capabilities
parameters.name: capacity_count

parameters.help_en: The job ID of the stream task
parameters.name: stream_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The data ingestion type. Valid values:
preset
custom

数据接入类型。取值：
preset
custom
parameters.name: data_ingestion_type

parameters.help_en: The data source ID for scan mode
parameters.name: scan_data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The update time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
